cases.title: Record visited link to Global History
cases.description: Precondition: Browser is open and Global History is enabled. Action: User visits a web link. Expected Behavior: The visited link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Precondition: Browser is open. Action: User navigates to a URL that triggers a server redirect. Expected Behavior: The final correct link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Precondition: History window is open with recorded history links. Action: User clicks on a history link. Expected Behavior: The link is launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete single History entry
cases.description: Precondition: History window is open with history entries. Action: User selects a single History entry and deletes it. Expected Behavior: The selected History entry is deleted.

cases.title: Delete multiple History entries
cases.description: Precondition: History window is open with multiple history entries. Action: User selects multiple History entries and deletes them. Expected Behavior: The selected multiple History entries are deleted and no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Precondition: History window is open with history entries. Action: User invokes the clear Global History command. Expected Behavior: Global History is completely cleared.

cases.title: Group History items by Day, Site, or None
cases.description: Precondition: History view is open. Action: User changes the grouping option to Day, Site, or None. Expected Behavior: History items are grouped accordingly by Day, Site, or None.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History table view is open. Action: User sorts and reverse-sorts each column. Expected Behavior: History is sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History table view is open. Action: User resizes history columns. Expected Behavior: History columns are resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and hide History columns
cases.description: Precondition: History table view is open. Action: User triggers show and hide options for history columns. Expected Behavior: History columns are successfully shown and hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Precondition: Browser window has a navigation history. Action: User clicks the dropdown menu on the Back or Forward button. Expected Behavior: Recently visited sites are re-visited via the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file on new window or restart
cases.description: Precondition: Browser application is closed or a new browser window is initiated. Action: User starts a new browser window or restarts the browser. Expected Behavior: A new, empty session history file is created.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are correctly mapped to well-defined and executable test cases with clear preconditions, actions, and expected behaviors.
